subject: Mutual acceptance timeline & security stitch for NorthShore MAP
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@northshorebank.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@northshorebank.com, security@northshorebank.com
Date: 2027-04-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Initial MAP asks — SOC 2 / DPA retention / CAIQ scope

Hi Vivek / Kimberly,

Thanks for the product walkthrough yesterday. The procurement and security teams at NorthShore reviewed the high-level slides and want to align a short mutual action plan (MAP) so legal can scope a DPA and we can complete security acceptance. A few things security asked to confirm before we draft a MAP: 

- Can you share a SOC 2 evidence inventory (what artifacts you can provide and approximate delivery dates)?
- Do you have a completed SIG/CAIQ (or partial) we can use to accelerate our questionnaire?
- DPA question: NorthShore requires a clear retention & deletion SLA for customer content (we typically expect deletion within 30 days of termination). Can you confirm your default retention windows for primary data, backups, and logs?
- Are there controls for EU data residency if we scope certain workloads to EU-only?

Can you propose a 3-week MAP with milestone owners so we can loop legal and security? Procurement would like an initial redline window for the DPA by EOW next week.

Attachments: none on my side yet.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Director, Third-Party Risk
NorthShore Bank
From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@northshorebank.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-04T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial MAP asks — SOC 2 / DPA retention / CAIQ scope

Elena — thanks for the clear list. We can align quickly. High level answers up front, then a draft MAP attached.

Quick answers:
- SOC 2: we maintain a Type II report; we can provide an evidence index mapped to the SOC 2 criteria. Lightweight gaps are typically addressed with statement-level artifacts; I attached a preliminary \"SOC2-evidence-index.pdf\" for visibility.
- CAIQ: we have a completed CAIQ export covering our hosted runtime and control plane. We'll share the CAIQ XLS separately if helpful.
- Retention & deletion: customer content (generated prompts/responses) default is 90 days for hosted API, with a 30-day deletion SLA available as a contractual commitment for enterprise accounts. Backups are retained for up to 90 days; audit/logs retention default 1 year but we can scope shorter windows.
- EU residency: we support region-scoped serving for EU-only workloads; we can commit to EU-residency for specific tenant data when requested in the MAP.

I attached a draft MAP (MAP-draft-v1.xlsx) with suggested milestones below. Owners: Vivek (commercial), Kimberly (security evidence), Laura (legal / DPA), Priyom (onboarding / engineering readiness).

Proposed 3-week timeline (high level):
1) Week 0 (Apr 5): Finalize MAP milestones & owners; procurement to share DPA redlines by Apr 9.
2) Week 1 (Apr 10–16): Security to review SOC2/CAIQ evidence; Redwood to provide any missing artifacts by Apr 14.
3) Week 2 (Apr 17–23): Legal exchange redlines and agree on retention SLA (target sign-off Apr 23).
4) Week 3 (Apr 24–28): Engineering readiness & small POC for EU-residency path; operational handoff.

Next steps: I attached MAP-draft-v1.xlsx and SOC2-evidence-index.pdf. Laura will pick up the DPA thread. Can you confirm procurement timeline and whether the 30-day deletion SLA is a blocker?

Regards,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of GTM Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachments: MAP-draft-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), SOC2-evidence-index.pdf (pdf)
From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@northshorebank.com>, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-06T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial MAP asks — SOC 2 / DPA retention / CAIQ scope

Elena — tagging in a few specifics from security side to shorten review cycles. Summary below and a suggested evidence handoff cadence.

SOC 2 evidence index highlights (attached):
- Encryption: AES-256 at rest; TLS 1.2+/TLS 1.3 in transit; KMS for key management (we can provide KMS usage logs and key rotation policy).
- Access controls: RBAC, SSO with SAML/OIDC, periodic access reviews.
- Change management: release notes and deploy approvals for the last 6 months are available.

Retention detail (operational defaults):
- Primary customer content (prompts/responses): default 90 days; contractual 30-day deletion SLA available and we will commit in DPA for enterprise customers.
- Backups: snapshot backups retained 90 days; point-in-time backups for critical accounts can be limited on request.
- Audit logs: 12 months by default; we can scope to 3 months on request for lower tiers.

Suggested evidence handoff cadence (to keep MAP moving):
- Apr 08: Prioritized SOC 2 artifacts for interview (access logs, KMS artefacts, change control runbook).
- Apr 14: Deliver remaining artifacts and a CAIQ export for your tool ingest.

Let me know any CAIQ fields you want prioritized (e.g., encryption, data residency, key management).

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
Attachments: SOC2-evidence-index.pdf
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@northshorebank.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, procurement@northshorebank.com
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, security@northshorebank.com
Date: 2027-04-07T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual acceptance timeline & security stitch for NorthShore MAP

Team — thank you, that helps. A few follow ups / redline asks before we route to legal for an initial DPA: 

1) Deletion SLA: procurement wants the 30-day deletion SLA for all customer content (including cached prefixes). Can you confirm you will include the 30-day contractual commitment for account termination? If backups take longer, we need explicit language describing backup retention and deletion sequencing.
2) EU residency: we will scope three sensitive workloads to EU-only. Please confirm process for validating EU-only residency (where data lives, replication behavior, and support windows).
3) CAIQ: please send the CAIQ XLS; we will ingest to our vendor risk tool and flag any mismatches.

Procurement target: initial redline to Laura by Apr 09 so we can keep the 3-week MAP timeline. Also please add a DocuSign link for the DPA when you have an internal sign-off.

Thanks,
Elena
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@northshorebank.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-09T16:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual acceptance timeline & security stitch for NorthShore MAP — DPA redline next steps

Elena — appreciate the timing request. We've reviewed the asks and can commit to the following for the DPA draft we will push to DocuSign: 

- 30-day deletion SLA for customer content after account termination (this will include cached prefixes and transient stores).
- Backup retention: backups may persist up to 90 days; the DPA will include explicit sequencing language stating that primary deletion completes within 30 days and backups are pruned per the 90-day schedule thereafter; we will include an escalation path to request expedited deletion for regulated workloads.
- EU residency: Redwood will provide tenant-level region controls and an attestation process (documentation + operational runbook) to demonstrate EU-only serving for the scoped workloads. We will include the attestation appendix in the MAP and DPA.

Next steps from Redwood:
- Apr 09 (today): Push DPA draft with the above commitments to DocuSign for your procurement/legal review. Link: https://app.docusign.com/rooms/NSB-DPA-2027
- Apr 14: Security to deliver CAIQ export and prioritized SOC2 artifacts for ingest.
- Apr 23: Target legal sign-off (per MAP).

If procurement sends redlines before EOD I can incorporate them into the DocuSign draft; otherwise expect the draft in the linked room. Priyom will stand up the EU-residency test cluster for a short smoke test in week 3 per the MAP timeline.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference
Attachments: DPA-redline-vNorthShore.docx (internal redline copy)\n
